notes:
Whole-first: the S1 record’s own movement path (#0 → #5→0) staged in order; every scene binds the S1 record (essay path + sha256 above) by its exact movement heading (verified present in the bound bytes at freeze time) plus one material record from the frozen inventory. Scene ids derive from the S record’s movement headings. Presentation mappings (tint, ground, term row, layout) are declared craft. Not corpus-complete: full per-product depth (all inventoried records as scenes) is the following fan-out.

Enrichment 2026-10-06 (wave 3, lane s-products). Per-scene moves — #0 s1-m0-articulation: quiet emergence (speed .45, turbulence .10, circulation .6, stillness pointer .06), one formation walks the five event verbs to 'acts' with brightening tint; layout line (the record's own term row). #1 s1-m1-freedom-event: gather (attract/implode pointer — freedom gathering into a committed movement), gravity draws the causes row together; a formation walks Svātantrya→Material→Efficient→Formal→Final→Will in the record's listing order, Will arriving larger. #2 s1-m2-act-knowledge: turn (vortex pointer — challenges turn the inquiry); the Scientific sequence itself walks the row left-to-right, Challenges tinted copper, an LFO breathes dispersion (traces breathe). #3 s1-m3-judgment-world: hold (guard pointer — the judgment field keeps its conditions distinct); relational orbital mode; the distribution→selection pair stages the mark's determination (spread dim field → small bright mark). #4 s1-m4-constitution-return: gather; layout ring (the Actuation circuit g⊳C⟲ΔW); the realised loop's own six terms walk the ring positions. #5->0 s1-m5-returned-judgment: settle — circulation reversed (-0.5), speed lowest, stillness pointer; the retained model-depth row dims back toward the implicate; the slowest LFO breathes speed.

3D: s1-m3-judgment-world is the 3D scene; z is J-Space's own distance dimension — near/salient possibilities nearest the viewer, excluded and far conditions deepest (the record: 'Distances, attractors, contradictions, permissions, source authority and reachable actions'); depthPerspective on with a warm depth tint. No other scene stages fake space.

Pointer profiles, by meaning: stillness (0.06 attract) for #0 and #5->0 (articulation begins and returns in quiet); attract/implode for #1 and #4 (gathering and return); vortex for #2 (the inquiry turns on challenges); guard repel for #3 (the field holds its edges). Automation lanes: dispersion LFO on #2 (the trace layer breathes), slow speed sine on #5->0 (the return breathes).
